Name: [Lit] Corpus maintained and gap statement re-checked
Description: Maintenance and verification only. The corpus is frozen at 59 reviewed papers. The gap statement carries a 2026-03-09 cutoff and is re-checked before each submission.

Name: [Lit] Structured gap verification
Description: Compares existing systems across aggregation method, regime detection, liquidity treatment and evaluation protocol. Matrix work on sheets that already exist. Requested in Week 4 section 2.2.

Name: [Lit] Survey matrix correction pass
Description: The 374-day correction, roughly 20 cells across 8 review notes. Needs a note revision with the paper check that implies, not a find and replace.

Name: [PP] Data reconciliation for the section 7 items
Description: DEPENDS ON: nothing. Universe chain, record populations, D27 added, D22 demoted. Both matrices patched and the reconciliation note written.

Name: [PP] Slides 14 to 22 and deck build
Description: DEPENDS ON: the data reconciliation for any quoted figure. Deck built 1 November, 22 slides. Outstanding: reference appendix, backup slides, pipeline diagram slide.

Name: [PP] Ethics application signed
Description: CRITICAL. A qualifying condition for the entire proposal mark. DEPENDS ON: signatures. Non-submission scores zero regardless of the deck.

Name: [PP] Rehearse and submit
Description: DEPENDS ON: deck complete, ethics signed.

Name: M1 PP submission
Description: MILESTONE. True when: slides submitted, signed Ethics Application submitted, and every section 7 data inconsistency either reconciled or stated as outstanding with a reason.

Name: [IPD] Liquidity profiling and final universe
Description: D17. DEPENDS ON: the adjusted panel, already built. Run against the official D27 panel, not the API extraction.

Name: [IPD] Point-in-time data layer and as-of cursor
Description: CANNOT SLIP. Point-in-time correctness cannot be retrofitted. The one ordering rule the build protects.

Name: M2 Point-in-time data layer accepted
Description: MILESTONE. True when: the as-of cursor raises on any row past the simulation clock rather than warning, and the cursor-violation test passes.

Name: M3 Adjusted dataset accepted
Description: MILESTONE. True when: raw, rejected and accepted record counts reconcile to one auditable figure, and the raw, cleaned and final eligible universes are each defined with every exclusion explained. Note: this milestone has no corresponding bar in the note 17 chart.

Name: [IPD] Agent output contract across four agents
Description: DEPENDS ON: the data layer and the as-of cursor.

Name: M4 Four agents behind one contract
Description: MILESTONE. True when: every agent returns all six fields with declared types and as_of equal to the cursor, on one ticker-date end to end.

Name: [IPD] Fundamental agent on the filings corpus
Description: DEPENDS ON: the filings corpus, secured at 22,893 documents. Model backbone is an open decision. Fallback is to stub it against a probe set while keeping it emitting the contract.

Name: M5 Fundamental agent live
Description: MILESTONE. True when: it answers from retrieved filings with every argument traceable to a retrieved figure, and usable coverage measured against a probe set rather than assumed.

Name: [IPD] State vector and orchestrator
Description: CANNOT SLIP. Acceptance criterion A3 is what the whole contribution rests on, which is why it sits eight days before IPD rather than on it.

Name: M6 Orchestrator responds to state
Description: MILESTONE. True when: A3 passes, the weight vector measurably responds to liquidity with the rest held fixed, with the sensitivity sweep plotted. If the weights are inert that is a finding, not a build failure.

Name: [IPD] Unit and integration suite
Description: Runs across the whole twelve weeks rather than one block, because the three tests that protect properties which cannot be retrofitted have to exist before the components they guard.

Name: [IPD] Chapters 1, 4, 5 and 6
Description: DEPENDS ON: nothing blocking. Required at IPD.

Name: M7 IPD
Description: MILESTONE. True when: a working prototype exists, every Must requirement has a test that runs, and chapters 1, 4, 5 and 6 are drafted.

Name: [Final] Full build and integration
Description: DEPENDS ON: architecture frozen.

Name: [Final] Persistence experiment
Description: The one explicitly unblocked path. Runs on a published paper's own four-ETF environment and needs no CSE data, so this sub-gap is off the critical path. Natural first task after submission.

Name: M8 Feature complete
Description: MILESTONE. True when: no Must requirement is untested, and the cost term sits inside the allocation objective rather than being deducted after it.

Name: [Final] Cost term inside the allocation objective
Description: DEPENDS ON: the build. Inside the objective, not deducted after it.

Name: [Final] Five arms, ablations and regime decomposition
Description: DEPENDS ON: a stable artefact and the adjusted panel. Five arms run over byte-identical cached agent outputs, which is acceptance criterion A5.

Name: M9 Evaluation complete
Description: MILESTONE. True when: five arms over byte-identical cached agent outputs, all ablations, regime decomposition, and the diagnostics reported whether or not they are favourable.

Name: [Final] Significance and stability sweeps
Description: 16 folds, HAC-adjusted test plus stationary bootstrap. Decided in advance that a null result is acceptable and will be reported.

Name: [Final] Thesis writing
Description: Runs the full nine weeks beside the build rather than following it, because nine weeks will not hold both in sequence.

Name: M10 Final submission
Description: MILESTONE. True when: thesis, artefact and code submitted, and the pipeline reproducible from a clean environment.
